The '''Darwikia system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the items known as [[Darwikian climbing pad]]s.<ref name="TatooineGhost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Darwikian climbing pad]]s|system=Darwikia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Darwikia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" />
